warnings.subject: evidence strength
warnings.finding: GET /health emits exactly one request-scoped log line, so the 'every log line' / '100% of lines' quantifiers in VM-003 and VM-004 are verified over n=1 at runtime. The multi-line-per-request case is covered only at test level.

warnings.subject: backend/src/api/middleware.py
warnings.finding: Caller-supplied X-Request-ID is reflected unbounded and unvalidated: a 5000-char id was written verbatim into the log line and echoed into the x-request-id response header (5015-byte header value). JSON-breaking characters are correctly escaped so the contract criterion holds, and h11 rejects bare control characters with a 400, but there is no length cap or charset allow-list. Security-reviewer territory; not a functional failure of any group-A check or AC.

warnings.subject: observability
warnings.finding: observability.enabled is true with metrics_path /metrics, but GET /metrics returns 404 and no group-A story, AC or feature owns a metrics endpoint. SLO error-rate sensor recorded untested. Orchestrator/manifest gap, not a group-A code defect.

warnings.subject: backend/src/config/logging.py
warnings.finding: PII redaction is opt-in via an explicit redact_values(...) scope, guarded by an architecture test rather than being ambient. Green today; fragile for the groups that will actually handle applicant payloads.

warnings.subject: E9-S1-AC1
warnings.finding: The AC says 'a schedule is computed' but E9-S1's own scope excludes interest/EMI rules, so no schedule exists in group A. Verified at the Money-arithmetic level over 200 random triples; the literal form should be re-verified when the schedule story lands.
